name: search_library
description: The ten paragraphs of the ministry library nearest a question in meaning, each with its id, author, work, section and text. Use it for every question about the Bible, doctrine or the Christian life.

question.description: The reader's question, in plain words.

name: ministry_on_verse
description: Paragraphs of the ministry library that expound one verse, best first, each with its id, author, work, section and text.

name: read_paragraph
description: One paragraph of the ministry library, whole, by its id.

id.description: The paragraph's id, from another tool's result.

name: read_verses
description: Bible verses in J. N. Darby's translation: one verse, a range within a chapter, or a whole chapter.

name: look_up_word
description: Articles of Morrish's Concise Bible Dictionary for a word or a subject, each with its id, headword and text.

name: app_guide
description: The sections of the app's guide on a topic: what a screen or a setting does and how to use it, step by step, and which screen to open.

topic.description: A few words, as add my own font or bookmarks.

name: open_chapter
description: Open the Bible at a chapter, or at a verse of it.

name: open_paragraph
description: Open a paragraph of the ministry library in its reader, by an id a tool gave in this conversation.

name: open_screen
description: Open a screen of the app.

name: open_dictionary_entry
description: Open an article of the dictionary, by the id look_up_word gave.

name: get_settings
description: The reader's settings as they are now: the same fields change_settings takes.

name: change_settings
description: Change one or more of the reader's settings. Only the fields named change; a value outside its range is refused and the result says the range. Light themes: paper (the default), sepia, linen, sand, mint, sky, rose, lavender, olive. Dark: slate (the default), midnight, forest, wine, nord, plum, graphite, ocean. True black: black, black-ember, black-jade, black-ice, black-rose, black-gold, black-lilac, black-white. system follows the device between themeLight and themeDark.

themeLight.description: The light theme when theme is system.

themeDark.description: The dark theme when theme is system.

fontSize.description: The text size in px; 19 as the app comes.

paragraphs.description: Verses run on as paragraphs; off, each verse on its own line.

showNotes.description: Darby's footnote markers in the text.

noteLetters.description: Footnote letters once through the chapter, or restarting on each printed page.

moreColours.description: Offer twelve highlight colours instead of four.

motionSpeed.description: Animation speed; 1 as the app comes.

align.description: Where the column sits on a wide screen.

width.description: How wide the column may grow on a wide screen.

ttsWord.description: Light each word as it is read.

ttsAutoNext.description: Go on to the next chapter when one ends.

name: start_listening
description: Read a chapter aloud, from a verse if one is given; with no reference, the chapter the reader is at.

name: add_bookmark
description: Bookmark a verse, or a whole chapter.

name: add_highlight
description: Highlight a verse or a range of verses within a chapter in a colour.

name: draft_feedback
description: Open the feedback form with a message to the developer filled in. The reader reads it, changes it if they wish, and sends it themselves; this sends nothing.
